items.title: Gig Driver Profit Checker — real delivery profit in minutes
items.zh_title: 「Gig Driver Profit Checker」：几分钟算清外卖跑单的真实收入
items.zh_oneliner: 这款由 Muse 按真实跑单员需求做出的网页应用，能对比多个外卖平台的单子，快速算出哪单真正赚钱。

items.en_title: Muse Ignites a New AI Growth Narrative: Meta Says Compute Efficiency Will Rise Tenfold Within a Year and High Profits Will Follow Within Years
